credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Image of the trunk of a yellow pine looking from the base upward, pine branches at top of tree.  This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Yellow Pine
